description: This file declares a class and functions related to rebuilding a super image within the Cuttlefish project. It includes licensing info, dependency includes, a class definition, a component declaration for dependency injection, and a function to check if a rebuild is needed.

classes.name: SuperImageRebuilder
classes.description: A class representing a setup feature related to super image rebuilding within the Cuttlefish framework.

methods.name: SuperImageRebuilderComponent
methods.description: A function that creates a dependency injection component providing SuperImageRebuilder and its required dependencies.

methods.name: SuperImageNeedsRebuilding
methods.description: A function that determines whether the super image needs to be rebuilt based on the provided fetcher configuration and target zip files.
